title: Golden Hour
metaDescription: 8.39ct Fancy Intense Yellow Cushion — a three-stone ring with warm gold prongs and contrasting trapezoid-cut diamonds. Bez Ambar, Los Angeles.
copy: This exceptional piece combines a fancy intense yellow cushion-cut diamond with a classic three-stone design, featuring warm gold prongs that echo the center stone's natural color. The contrasting brilliance of two colorless trapezoid-cut diamonds frames the cushion center, completing a balanced, architectural silhouette.
